gigs.title: John Snow Labs: Healthcare Data Scientist (Remote, International)
gigs.body:
You'll work on customer projects, where hospitals, payers and pharma companies use our software on their own data. Your work includes:
Model training: fine-tune LLM and NLP models for entity extraction, assertion status and relation extraction on clinical notes, using Spark NLP for Healthcare and open-source Python libraries.
Extraction pipelines: pull structured facts from clinical notes, pathology and radiology reports, scanned PDFs and DICOM images, and remove PHI from them.
Data harmonization: map what you extract to the OMOP common data model, FHIR and clinical terminologies (SNOMED CT, ICD-10, RxNorm, LOINC) to build each patient's journey.
Validation: test models for bias, overfitting and drift before and after they go live.
Customer work: scope problems with customer data teams, explain results to clinicians and engineers, and write up what you built.
Requirements: 5+ industry years on clinical dataYou need all of these:
At least 5 years as a hands-on data scientist or ML engineer in industry, delivering projects that went into production. Academic work alone, or apps built only by calling an LLM API, isn't enough.
Proven work on clinical data: clinical notes, pathology or radiology reports, medical images, EHR records, or OMOP and FHIR datasets. Experience limited to claims or billing data doesn't qualify.
Strong hands-on expertise with PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain / LangSmith, Spark NLP, or related open-source libraries.
Proven working knowledge of current software development tools such as GitHub, Docker, AWS / Azure, Claude Code / Codex.
Clear written and spoken English, since you'll present to customer teams every week.
PhD or MD and Healthcare AI Industry Experience Preferred
These put your application near the top of the pile:
A PhD in computer science, biomedical informatics, biostatistics or a related field, or an MD, plus industry experience after it.
Work at a clinical NLP or healthcare AI company, a cloud healthcare AI service, or the data science team of a health system, payer or pharma company.
Hands-on use of Spark NLP, Healthcare NLP or our Medical LLM.
Peer-reviewed papers or shared-task results in clinical NLP or medical imaging, for example at AMIA, ACL, NAACL or EMNLP.
De-identification, OMOP ETL, or work with research clinical datasets such as MIMIC.
Long-term freelance contract worldwide
You'll work remotely as an independent contractor on a long-term contract of 30 to 40 hours a week. This isn't a full-time employment role, and we contract with individuals only, not agencies or teams. You can apply from any country except those where US sanctions or our own policy prevent us from contracting.
John Snow Labs is profitable and has never taken venture or debt financing, so we hire for multi-year work.
Apply yourself: we don't review submissions from recruiters or agencies. Your cover letter should include the words "John Snow Labs", the country you live in now, one clinical data project you delivered (the dataset, your role, the model or method, the result), and links to your GitHub or papers. Applications without these are hard for us to assess, so we may not reply to them.
John Snow Labs is looking for senior healthcare data scientists to build clinical LLM and NLP pipelines for more than 500 enterprise customers in healthcare and life sciences. This is a remote contract of at least 30 hours a week, open to individuals in most countries.
You'll join a team that works across 28 countries, where 33% of members hold a PhD or MD and 75% hold at least a master's degree. Our software includes Healthcare NLP, Medical LLM, visual language models, multimodal de-identification, OMOP harmonization, and the Patient Journey Intelligence platform.
John Snow Labs has won 50+ industry awards, including Frost & Sullivan's 2026 Customer Value Leadership Award for Healthcare Large Language Models, and was ranked first among 190+ companies by MarketsandMarkets for NLP in Healthcare and Life Sciences.

gigs.body:
About 2hourglass
2hourglass is a fast, mobile window and door glass repair company based in Pennsylvania. Our technicians go to the customer's home or business and fix broken glass, foggy (failed-seal) glass and window hardware on site, often the same or next day. About 80% of our work is residential and 20% commercial.
Our promise is in the name: speed and certainty. Customers send a photo, get a price, and we fix the one window they need. We don't push them to replace five. That approach has earned us roughly 1,300 five-star Google reviews.
Our biggest opportunity is the homeowners who don't know their window can be repaired at all, so they live with it. Our new website is live. Over the next 6–12 months we're improving its conversion, sharpening our Google and Facebook ads, and launching email and SMS follow-up. Over the next 2–3 years we want a marketing machine that runs without depending on the founder. This role is the first step toward that.
This is a fantastic opportunity for a results-driven, hands-on person to join our team. The role is remote, part-time, and headquartered in Pennsylvania (US Eastern time).The role
As our Marketing Coordinator, you'll plan, coordinate and carry out our marketing across the website, Google Ads, Facebook/Meta, email, SMS and reviews. You'll be our first and only in-house marketing person.
You'll work directly with the founder. He sets the strategy and big-picture goals; you own the day-to-day execution and keep projects moving. We also work with an outside marketing coach, so you'll have a clear plan and support.

Starts at 20 hours/week, with potential to grow toward full-time

Remote; overlap with US Eastern business hours required

Founder
Pay

Website performance and metrics (top priority). Our new website is live. Track how it and our Google Ads landing pages perform (traffic, bounce rate, calls and quote requests) and make the adjustments the numbers call for: copy, offers, reviews and calls to action. Keep each county and service page current and working.
Paid ads coordination. Support our Google Ads (people ready to book now) and Facebook/Meta ads (people who don't know repair is possible). Brief and manage ad creative, and work with any outside agency or freelancer.
Content and social media. Plan and run a content calendar that teaches homeowners their broken, foggy or sticking windows can be repaired. Create, schedule and post content, reply to comments, and repurpose content across channels.
Copywriting. Write and edit copy for the website, ads, emails, SMS and social posts in a clear, friendly, local-business voice.
Email, SMS and CRM. Build and manage welcome, follow-up and reactivation campaigns in our CRM (Close). Re-engage stalled leads and past customers.
Reviews and social proof. Turn our ~1,300 five-star Google reviews into marketing assets. Keep our Google Business Profile active and fresh.
Offers and referrals. Help launch and promote a low-cost entry offer and simple referral and repeat-customer programs.
Tracking and reporting. Maintain a weekly marketing dashboard: leads by source, cost per lead and per job, landing-page performance and ad return. Flag what's working and what isn't.
Project management. Create and keep project timelines, manage freelancers and vendors, and make sure campaigns ship on time.
Coordination with the team. Work with the founder and office team so marketing, lead follow-up and scheduling stay aligned.
Your first 90 days
By day 90, we should see clearly which marketing produces booked jobs, and the website should be converting better than at your start.
Timeframe
What success looks like
Days 1–30
You know our services, customers, brand and tools (Close CRM, website, ad accounts). Our weekly marketing dashboard is up to date. Stalled leads from Facebook have been followed up.
Days 31–60
You've set a baseline for website and landing-page conversion and made a first round of data-driven adjustments, such as stronger use of our reviews and the "send a photo, get a price" offer. A content calendar is running on Facebook.
Days 61–90
Website and landing-page conversion has improved against the day-30 baseline. Welcome and reactivation email/SMS sequences are live. The entry offer and a referral program are launched. You present a monthly results report to the founder.
What we're looking forThe six non-negotiables
Copywriting. You'll write for the web, ads, email, SMS and social media. Your writing must be excellent, and we'll ask for samples.
Tech-savvy. You don't need to be a technical expert, but you pick up new tools fast: CRMs, website builders, ad platforms, email tools and AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity.
Project management. You set deadlines, keep them, and move several projects forward at once.
Self-starter. Goals will be clear. Often it'll be up to you to decide what needs to happen, when and how, and then do it without being chased.
Teachable and coachable. We do marketing differently, and there's a lot to learn on the job. We hire mainly on attitude.
Leadership potential. You'll start as our only marketer. As you hit goals, we expect this role to grow into leading a small marketing team.
Nice to have
Experience marketing a local or home-services business (trades, cleaning, HVAC, roofing, real estate)

gigs.body:
Headquarters: Remote - United States
Applying to Paxos? Our only careers site is paxos.com/careers, and we only recruit via @paxos.com email. Details below.
___
About Paxos
Today’s financial infrastructure is archaic, expensive, inefficient and risky — supporting a system that leaves out more people than it lets in. So we’re rebuilding it.
We’re on a mission to open the world’s financial system to everyone by enabling the instant movement of any asset, any time, in a trustworthy way. For over a decade, we’ve built blockchain infrastructure that tokenizes, custodies, trades and settles assets for the world's leading financial institutions, like PayPal, Venmo, Mastercard, Interactive Brokers and Charles Schwab.
About the team
Product Security works across engineering to secure our applications and services. Partnering closely with engineering, we integrate security into every stage of development, from design documents to code reviews and CI/CD deployment pipelines. Our focus centers on secure defaults, intelligent automation, and pragmatic solutions rather than bureaucracy. We integrate AI tooling into our everyday testing, code review, and workflow automation. Operating within a highly regulated environment, our work safeguards customer trust and regulatory standing, requiring an exceptionally high standard of execution.
About the role
As a Senior Application Security Engineer, you will act as a key security partner across product and engineering teams, taking ownership of threat modeling, architecture reviews, and application code assessments, and supporting smart contract reviews. You will maintain and advance our automated security tooling to detect vulnerabilities early in the development lifecycle. Given our cloud-native infrastructure, you will continuously evaluate application and infrastructure security in tandem, analyzing deployment pipelines, service boundaries, access controls, and identity management. Rather than addressing vulnerabilities individually, you will focus on building scalable guardrails and secure design patterns, balancing robust security controls with product velocity and user experience. You will write code yourself, building the libraries, guardrails, and fixes, and you will be the security lead for the teams you support, mentoring engineers along the way. You will exercise significant autonomy and directly shape the evolution of our Application Security program.
What you'll do
Drive security design reviews and threat modeling initiatives for new products and major updates, evaluating both application architecture and cloud deployment strategies.
Conduct comprehensive security assessments and secure code reviews on critical APIs and services, targeting business logic, data governance, and authorization mechanisms.
Support reviews of blockchain integrations and smart contracts, collaborating closely with engineering teams and third-party auditors to remediate vulnerabilities.
Build security guardrails into CI/CD (SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, and supply chain safeguards) and keep findings high-signal to maintain developer trust.
Triage and prioritize security findings from bug bounties, penetration tests, and automated scanners based on contextual risk, steering them to resolution.
Write code: build the libraries, guardrails, and fixes yourself instead of handing findings back to teams.
Establish secure-by-default architecture, reusable libraries, and best-practice frameworks to systematically resolve entire classes of security vulnerabilities.
Partner with cloud security specialists to enforce application-level controls, including service identity management, network segmentation, and secrets handling.
Leverage AI platforms to automate workflows, accelerate review and triage capabilities, and expand program impact.
Assist in incident response efforts for application-layer events and lead post-incident security strengthening initiatives.
Act as the security lead for the teams you support, and provide actionable security guidance and mentorship to engineering teams to foster a culture of secure development.
About you
5+ years combined in software engineering and application security, including hands-on experience building and shipping production software
Strong software development and secure code review skills in at least one of Go, Java, Python, or TypeScript, with the ability to quickly evaluate unfamiliar codebases
Practical expertise in threat modeling as well as web and API security, specifically targeting business logic, authentication, and authorization vulnerabilities
Demonstrated experience securing cloud-native applications (preferably AWS), covering containers and Kubernetes, IAM, secrets management, service-to-service authentication, and CI/CD pipelines
Proven ability to scale security mitigation using secure design patterns, automated tooling, and shared frameworks
Track record of implementing and fine-tuning CI/CD automated security scanners to minimize noise and false positives
Basic understanding of cryptography and blockchain; applied cryptography or hands-on smart contract audit experience is a plus
Regular adoption of AI coding and static analysis tools for development and auditing, alongside an informed perspective on their effective application
Strong verbal and written communication skills to collaborate effectively with software engineers, product management, and engineering leadership
Proven history of partnering with engineering teams to resolve security vulnerabilities rather than simply cataloging them
Experience mentoring engineers and acting as the security lead for an area

We only use @paxos.com email addresses

You'll own and report on:
Win rate against named primary competitors
Competitive displacement, meaning deals won where an incumbent competitor was in seat
Deal velocity and influenced ACV in competitive opportunities
Field adoption of competitive assets, measured rather than assumed

7+ years in competitive intelligence, product marketing, or strategic GTM in B2B SaaS, with demonstrated success building competitive programs and enablement assets that measurably moved win rates and deal velocity.

Experience in work management, collaboration, knowledge management, or adjacent enterprise SaaS categories.
Hands on with CI and revenue tooling: [Klue, Clozd, Clari, Salesforce, Gemi, Claude, etc ].
Direct experience contributing to major industry research: Gartner Magic Quadrant, Forrester Wave, or equivalent.
Comfort with pricing intelligence, packaging analysis, and contract negotiation dynamics.
Financial literacy. You can pull an insight out of a company's annual filings.

You'll report into Product Marketing Management and partner closely with Product Management, Revenue Enablement, Sales, and Executive Leadership as the resident expert on competitive dynamics: strategic advisor to leadership, trusted tactical partner to the field.

You'll guide SIs on architecture, integrations, data sync, and configuration. When something breaks, you'll figure out whether it's a configuration issue, an integration issue, or a real product defect, and get it to the right owner.
You'll sit in the Partner Center of Excellence, the team responsible for making partner delivery repeatable and high quality. Our Partner Alliance Managers own the overall relationship with each partner and this role will be responsible for the successful technical outcome and capability development. You'll work daily with Sales, Professional Services, Product, Engineering, and Support, and you'll turn what you learn on each project into playbooks the whole ecosystem can use.

Job Responsibilities
What you'll do
Guide Partners to Go-live
Serve as the product & technical point of contact for SI partners and their customers during the implementation project and through go-live.
Advise on solution architecture, integration design, data synchronization, and configuration best practices across Agiloft's platform: core CLM, procurement and source-to-pay workflows, ERP sync (such as SAP S/4HANA), APIs and MCP-based orchestration, and AI and analytics capabilities.
Help partners separate out-of-the-box capability from custom implementation work so each fix lands with the right owner.
Own the Technical Escalation Path
Act as the Tier 3 technical resource for partner-led projects.
Triage and reproduce issues, document them clearly, and log true defects and enhancement requests to Product and Engineering in Jira.
Join partner and customer working sessions when a blocker needs Agiloft in the room.
Hand accounts off cleanly to Support at transition, with documented configuration and open items.
Enable the Ecosystem
Build and deliver partner training, webinars, and learning content with Product and go-to-market teams.
Work with Product and Engineering to stand up and maintain partner sandboxes, test environments, and knowledge base access.
Support the change management and promote the value of monthly releases into the partner ecosystem.
Build the Playbook
Create and maintain implementation playbooks, a known-issue library, escalation runbooks, and environment setup guides.
Feed patterns from real projects back into enablement, documentation, and the product roadmap.
What Success Looks Like in Year One
Partner-led go-lives land on schedule, with fewer slipping because of unresolved technical blockers.

Product and Engineering receive structured, prioritized signal from partner projects instead of ad hoc pulls.

A working go-live toolkit exists and partners actually use it: playbooks, known-issue library, runbooks, reference architectures, and environment guides.
Support inherits cleaner, better-documented accounts at handoff.
Target metrics: e.g. on-time go-live rate, median time to resolve partner escalations, escalations per quarter, training events delivered.

Agiloft certification, or relevant platform certifications (Salesforce, SAP, cloud).
Hands-on experience designing and troubleshooting enterprise integrations including REST APIs, webhooks, authentication patterns (OAuth, JWT), and data sync between systems of record.

Experience guiding external partners or customers while working across Product, Engineering, and Support.
Exposure to AI-enabled workflows, LLM tooling, or MCP-based integrations.
A builder's habit of turning one-off fixes into reusable documentation and process.

gigs.title: StarTree: Technical Support Engineer
gigs.body:
At StarTree we're a group of passionate individuals that desire to improve the lives of many by developing tools and technologies that support availability and speed in the world of real-time analytics. 
Our aim is to make it simple for every company to delight their users - external and internal - and create new revenue streams from their data, by building the world’s most comprehensive and accessible cloud analytics system.
About the Role
Support is a cornerstone of success at StarTree and a highly valued function within the organization. As a Technical Support Engineer, you will become a critical interface between customers and StarTree’s cross-functional teams, providing technical expertise and driving customer satisfaction.
This role requires you to become a subject matter expert on Apache Pinot and the StarTree Platform, delivering exceptional support to ensure customers achieve success. You’ll play a vital role in providing on-call support for urgent production issues, acting as a trusted advisor for resolving complex challenges.
At StarTree, learning and growth are at the heart of what we do. We are deeply committed to helping our team continuously build their technical skill sets, explore innovative solutions, and grow alongside our evolving platform.
StarTree is growing rapidly, with near-perfect customer renewal rates. This success has led to the rapid expansion of our support team, mirroring the increase in the number of customers leveraging StarTree solutions.
Responsibilities
Collaborate closely with field technical teams and Engineering to troubleshoot and resolve performance and configuration issues for StarTree customers.
Provide exceptional customer support through tickets and Slack Connect, with the option to leverage Zoom for more complex cases.
Contribute to StarTree’s knowledge base by documenting solutions, best practices, and lessons learned. Mentor and train team members to promote a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
Act as the voice of the customer, proactively sharing product feedback, feature requests, and trends with development teams to drive innovation and enhance the StarTree product roadmap.
Create internal tooling and identify opportunities to improve existing processes to increase team efficiency and effectiveness.
Work effectively both individually and as part of a team, always striving to delight customers and embodying values of customer service and responsiveness.
Work with advanced data technologies, including vector indexes, to support AI-driven innovations across diverse industries.
Qualifications
Contract to Hire Role. Exceptions will be made for highly qualified candidates for direct hire.
4-6 years of experience in one of the roles: Support engineering, Sales engineering, Solutions Architect, SRE, Full stack developer.
Hands-on experience with open-source data technologies.
Familiarity with modern OLAP systems such as Apache Pinot, Druid, or Clickhouse is a plus.
Experience with big data technologies like Spark, Hadoop, and Presto/Trino is a plus.
Strong understanding of and hands-on experience with OLAP, Analytics, Kubernetes and SQL.
Experience and/or strong understanding of streaming technologies such as Apache Kafka.
Proven troubleshooting skills across systems, applications, network, JVM, and Linux-based applications.
Strong knowledge of cloud infrastructure patterns and services within at least one of the major public clouds: Amazon AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure.
Bonus points: Certification in Solutions Architecture for one or more of the major public clouds (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure).
Bonus points: Degree in Computer Science with a focus on Data Science, Data Engineering, or Data Analytics.
About StarTree:
StarTree is a cloud-based software company that enables business customers to derive advanced insights from real-time and historical data. StarTree was founded by the core software engineering team and inventors of Apache Pinot, which currently powers hundreds of user-facing applications at companies across industries, including LinkedIn, Uber, Target, 7Eleven, Etsy, Walmart, WePay, Factual, Weibo, and more. StarTree Cloud has enabled even more companies to deploy and operate real-time analytics at scale, including Stripe, Sovrn, Roadie, Just Eat Takeaway.com, Dialpad, Guitar Center, Blinkit, and more.
StarTree recently announced our Series B Funding with investment from GGV Capital, Sapphire Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, and CRV. We have been named one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups and one of CRN's 10 Coolest Cloud Computing Startup Companies of 2022!

gigs.body:

The role will focus on identifying new business opportunities, developing a sustainable sales pipeline, strengthening client relationships, and implementing effective sales and marketing strategies to expand the organization's market presence and achieve its commercial objectives.Key Responsibilities
Formulate and recommend strategic sales and marketing plans aligned with the organization's revenue, profitability, and business growth objectives.
Establish effective sales pipeline development strategies, lead-generation processes, and opportunity management practices to drive consistent business growth.
Identify new business opportunities, target markets, strategic partnerships, and potential clients to expand the organization's customer base and market reach.

Provide direction on brand positioning, marketing campaigns, digital marketing initiatives, and lead-generation strategies to enhance market visibility and customer engagement.
Establish and maintain relationships with prospective clients, key accounts, strategic partners, and industry stakeholders to support long-term business opportunities.
Collaborate with internal teams to develop competitive value propositions, tailored customer solutions, and effective market-entry and business development approaches.

Demonstrated expertise in market identification, lead generation and qualification, sales pipeline development, proposal preparation, commercial negotiations, and contract acquisition.
Strong understanding of sales strategies, market positioning, pricing models, customer acquisition, and revenue growth initiatives.
Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, relationship management, and stakeholder engagement skills.
Strong analytical and strategic planning capabilities, with the ability to assess market trends, interpret sales performance data, and identify growth opportunities.
Experience working with international teams and remote stakeholders.
Experience selling technical, engineering, software, AI, cloud, data, or other technology-driven solutions.
Must be based in the United States and legally authorized to work in the U.S.
